title: PDF Studio and NLP Action Bar Specification

crossover.trigger: User requests multiple operations or operations unsupported by the active single-purpose tool.
crossover.action: Open a full-screen, smooth fade-in modal (nearly opaque background) presenting the message: 'Perform multiple ops at the same time, in pdf studio'.

controls.proceed: Navigates to PDF Studio and preserves loaded files in global or context state.
controls.cancel: Closes the modal and remains in the current tool.

api.sdk: Google Gen AI API using system instructions to enforce structured JSON output.

payload.prompt: User input text (e.g. 'delete the first page of report.pdf')
payload.files: Array of { name: string, pageCount: number } currently in workspace

schema.message: string (e.g., 'Perform multiple ops at the same time, in pdf studio')
schema.commands: Array of { action: 'rotate'|'delete'|'merge'|'split'|'number', fileName: string, parameters: object }

layout.centerPanel: Interactive client-side PDF document preview pages (using pdfjs-dist)
